text.en: A true artist is devoted to his art regardless of age or tiredness.

Paaichal is a short story by Sa. Kandasamy. It says a real artist gives himself wholly to his art, stands apart from other artists with his own special qualities, and is not hampered by age or physical weariness.
The story shows dedication and originality in art. It encourages us to follow our passion with full commitment.
Terms: பாய்ச்சல் (a leap), கலைஞன், ஈடுபாடு (involvement) and தனித்தன்மை (uniqueness).
